name: Claude Browser Use Demo
description: Containerised reference showing Claude automating a Chromium browser through a Playwright-backed browser tool.
whatItDoes: Through a Streamlit interface users ask Claude to navigate sites, interact with page elements, extract content and fill forms. It is a minimal reference for DOM-level browser automation.
howItWorks: A Docker container runs Streamlit, a virtual display and Chromium under Playwright. Claude is given a custom browser tool and the loop executes each requested action and returns the result.
